episodes.title: WHEN THE MOON RISES, WE SHARE A MESSAGE
episodes.logline: Kuro intercepts a fragmented night carrier and learns from Vesper why incomplete evidence must remain honestly incomplete.

episodes.title: DEAD FREQUENCY
episodes.logline: A dormant rooftop repeater wakes on a three-year-old carrier frequency, pulling Kuro toward the anonymous night switchboard.

episodes.title: TWO TIMESTAMPS
episodes.logline: Two conflicting log slips arrive for the same rooftop event; Vesper preserves both records side-by-side without silent overwriting.

episodes.title: RAIN ON THE RELAY
episodes.logline: During a nocturnal downpour, Kuro and anonymous rooftop technician crew-01 stabilize the northern aerial without losing the live tape.

episodes.title: THE UNREDACTED MARGIN
episodes.logline: A viral city rumor tries to fill in the blank bars from EP-01; Vesper prints a margin-annotated zine correcting the record.

episodes.title: NEXT PHASE DAWN
worldRules: END OF AN ERA -> NEXT PHASE
episodes.logline: As first light touches Moon City's skyline, the night archive closes its folio and hands the surviving trace to the next phase.
